title: S08T03 - Reduce time-to-first-value and make recovery progressive
description: Build onboarding fixtures, concise output profiles, contextual help, error recovery, and bounded handoffs that minimize setup questions and agent context consumption.
acceptanceCriteria: A clean user completes installation and one verified work loop in under five minutes using only public golden-path documentation.
Transcript regression budgets bound invocations, JSON bytes, prompt tokens, and recovery steps for normal and failed paths.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
